categories.main_business_segments: Obara Group operates three main business segments: welding equipment (primarily for automotive body welding), surface polishing equipment (mainly for silicon wafers and crystal substrates in the electronics industry), and electrical equipment (mainly distribution equipment for the electric power industry). Each segment is supported by a network of domestic and international subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced resistance welding technology, including high-speed and lightweight welding guns for automotive applications, and precision surface polishing technologies such as dry etching and double-sided polishing for semiconductor substrates. In the electrical equipment segment, it utilizes layered molding techniques for cable connection equipment and develops products to improve reliability and reduce CO2 emissions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers (for welding equipment), electronics and semiconductor companies (for polishing equipment), and electric utilities (for electrical equipment). The company’s products are essential in automotive body assembly, semiconductor wafer processing, and power distribution infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: Obara Group has a global footprint with operations and subsidiaries in Japan, China, Korea, Southeast Asia (Thailand, Malaysia, India), the United States, Mexico, Brazil, Europe (UK, France, Italy, Czech Republic), and Taiwan. Sales are well-diversified across Japan, Asia-Pacific, the Americas, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier, manufacturing and selling equipment and consumables directly to OEMs and end-users in the automotive, electronics, and power industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include global expansion, local market adaptation, and leveraging proprietary technologies for product differentiation. R&D focuses on next-generation high-speed, lightweight welding guns, high-precision and high-efficiency polishing systems, and environmentally friendly, labor-saving electrical equipment. The company also emphasizes sustainability, quality improvement, and expanding recurring revenue from consumables.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of capital equipment (welding and polishing machines), consumables (such as electrodes and polishing materials), and electrical distribution components. Additional income streams include after-sales service, spare parts, and, to a lesser extent, royalties and management fees from group companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Obara Group is a leading global supplier in resistance welding equipment for automotive applications and a significant player in the surface polishing equipment market for semiconductors. Major competitors include other specialized welding and polishing equipment manufacturers, but Obara differentiates itself through its global presence, technical expertise, and strong relationships with major OEMs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated sales reached 61.7 billion yen (approx. $410 million), with operating profit of 9.7 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 6.8 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with a 9.4% year-on-year increase in sales, and maintains a strong balance sheet with an equity ratio above 70%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Obara Group emphasizes high quality, reliability, and technical innovation tailored to customer needs. Its unique value lies in proprietary technologies for high-speed, lightweight welding guns, advanced polishing systems for next-generation semiconductors, and robust, easy-to-install electrical equipment. The company’s global support network and ability to deliver both equipment and consumables provide customers with comprehensive, long-term value.
